项目功能或用途: Recently, the Muon optimizer based on matrix orthogonalization has demonstrated strong results in training small-scale language models, but the scalability to larger models has not been proven. Scaling law experiments indicate that Muon achieves ∼ 2× computational efficiency compared to AdamW with compute optimal training.
